newsitem.title: GERMANY: No German rate change this week - Bundesbank poll.
newsitem.headline: No German rate change this week - Bundesbank poll.

text.p: Following are the results of a poll of 10 economists on the expected outcome of this week's Bundesbank council meeting. The poll was conducted on Monday.
1. Will the Bundesbank change its leading interest rates
this week?
Yes 0
No 10
2. Will there be a cut in the discount and lombard rates later this year?
Yes 0
No 10
3. Will there be a rise in the discount and lombard rates later this year?
Yes 0
No 10
4. Will there be another fixed tender at 3.00 percent this Thursday?
Yes 10
No 0
Detailed results of the poll as follows:
Economist 1. 2. 3. 4.

Rosane Maddalena, San Paolo Bank, Lond. No No No Yes
David Brickmann, Yamaichi Int. Europe No No No Yes
Peter Kerger, Credit Suisse Ffm No No No Yes

Wieland Staud, Yamaichi Bank, Ffm No No No Yes
Ulrich Hombrecher, Westdt. Landesbank No No No Yes
